If both traced, pool 900,000 before police trimming; retaining all routines keeps this above 300,000 even after ten 5% trims (~539,000). Avoid new sources until feedback supports doing so. Timing-safe daily schedule: 2 quick morning, 2 quick afternoon, 1 timed evening; no routine is busy during more than 2 deaths. Press reports can be false by factor 3, so do not trust one report. Baseline sustainable strategy earns 5/day without capture.

Day 2: continue using only web and foreign sources plus national, earning 5/day. If both sources traced, pool is 900,000 before police trimming and about 539,000 after ten 5% trims. Preserve all routines: 2 quick morning, 2 quick afternoon, 1 timed evening means no routine is busy during more than 2 deaths that day. Do not add sources without strong evidence: a third traced source risks capture. Press announcements every 3 days are rounded and roughly one-third false by factor 3; do not trust a single report. Day 1 earned 5; today's plan adds 5.
